purpose: Teach: アットホーム/ともなっ/見なし/三四郎/インテリジェント/平年/山川/加護

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新しい部室がアットホームで居心地良いって言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you said the new club room felt homey and comfortable.
lines.style: Light, testing tone. Leaning in slightly. Watching his face for a reaction—curious but not quite innocent about bringing it up.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「成長にともなって悩みも増える」って言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You told me worries grow when you do, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turning it back on her. Quiet observation—not accusing, just calling her own words forward. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ライバルって「強敵と見なし」てたな
lines.en: Riku, you used to look at rivals like they were real threats.
lines.style: Accusatory but affectionate. Tilting her head. Building something—not letting him off the hook easily.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、国語で夏目漱石の三四郎読まされてたな、桜
lines.en: You had to read Natsume Soseki's Sanshiro for Japanese class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Countering smoothly. Casual deflection—eyes steady. Matching her energy but refusing to be cornered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「インテリジェントなクラスメート」って一目置いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you had some respect for that intelligent classmate, didn't you?
lines.style: Narrowing slightly. Softer now—not quite a challenge, more like she's circling something real. Slower pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏休みの自由研究で平年比の気象記録調べたろ、桜
lines.en: You did a summer research project on weather patterns compared to the average year, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Factual, patient. Like he's laying down evidence. Voice even, but there's intent—he remembers what she didn't think he was listening to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、地理で山川の地形描いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you used to sketch landforms in geography class.
lines.style: Softer attack. Not really a question anymore. She's stopped circling—she's holding something still, looking at it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祖母様が「神様のご加護を」って言ってたな、桜
lines.en: Your grandmother said 'may the gods protect you,' didn't she, Sakura?
lines.style: Very quiet. Drawing the thread to its end. Almost reverential—not mocking. This is where he stops deflecting.
